title: Stationarity as a One-Mode Constraint on Quantum Correlation
summary: A stationary scalar correlation energy admits an exact one-mode terminal representation even when the microscopic correlated return is strongly multimode. We test predictive realizations built from specified stationary information carriers in two complementary two-electron systems with the same Coulomb repulsion but different confinement: He-like ions and harmonium (Hooke's atom). For the Coulomb sequence, canonical RHF supplies the symmetry-faithful information carrier.
